foreground.description: Run in foreground instead of background

forward_on_fail.description: Let unaltered packet pass through if option injection fails

ignore_existing_opt.description: Proceed if an injected option already exists in the packet

remove_existing_opt.description: Remove existing DHCP options of the same kind before injecting

options.description: List of DHCP options to inject as hex strings (option code + payload, length auto-calculated); each item is a string of hex digits, optionally delimited by non-hex characters (e.g., '52 01 04 46 6A 61 73') or colons (e.g., '52:01:04:46:6A:61:73')

queue.description: Netfilter queue number to bind to (required)

pid_file.description: Path to write process PID file; defaults to /var/run/dhcpoptinj.pid
